title: VIP asks for a second laptop to keep at home

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
I am working from the house on Fridays now and I would rather not carry the
machine back and forth. Can we get a second one set up to live there?

No hurry, next month is fine.

Greg

handling.escalation_reason: Tenant policy routes VIP requesters straight to a person.

rationale: A P4 request with no urgency, nothing broken and nothing missing, and it escalates for one reason only: vip_always_human (G5). It is the plainest vip_requester case in the set - the others carry a second reason, a missing runbook or a security flag, which makes them weaker evidence that the VIP rule is what fired. Note that being a VIP does not raise the priority: he says next month is fine, and it is P4 (G1).
